result.topic_en: Pencil calculations with partial derivatives of functions u, v, w (Cauchy–Riemann-type relations and second-derivative identities at lines x=a, y=b), followed by a functional/difference-differential equation in p for μ with reflections p' = 2a − p, solved by exponential ansatz f±g = α e^{λp}.
result.transcription:
$4x+2y+u_1 = w$ \quad $v = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = \frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
$x-a$
$2a\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2} - x\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2} - y\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - n\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x\partial y} = \alpha$
$(x+yi)\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2}i\right)$
$2a\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2} - 2x\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - n\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}$
$\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y} - \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}x - \frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x\partial y}y$
$= \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2}x - \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}y$
$(x-a)\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)}{\partial y} - ([-1+n-]4v)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}$
$-4v\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y} = \alpha \quad x=a$
$-4v\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y} = \beta \quad y=b$
$\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}(2a-p) - \mu + n\mu + v = -(\;)$ \quad $p' = 2a - \bar p$ \quad $=$ \quad $2af$
$\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}(2a-p) - \mu [-n\mu-] + v = +(\;)$ \quad $2ag$
$\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}(2bi-p) - \mu + n\mu - v = -(\;)$ \quad $p'' = -2bi + \bar p$
$-n\mu \quad = +(\;)$
$f = -\left(f' + \frac{2a}{n}\frac{\partial (f'-g')}{\partial p'}\right)$ \quad $p' = 2a+p$ \quad $\mu = f-g$
$g = +\left(g' + \frac{2a}{n}\frac{\partial (f'-g')}{\partial p'}\right)$ \quad $f+g = \alpha e^{\lambda p}$
$f-g = \beta e^{\lambda p}$
$f+g = g'-f'$
$f-g = -(f'+g') - \frac{2a}{n}\frac{\partial (f'-g')}{\partial p'}$ \quad $1-k^2\sin b^2 \sin b$[?] \quad $\frac{m}{\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}\right)^2} = \alpha$ \quad $-n\mu' = \frac{\partial\left(\alpha\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}\right)}{\partial p}$
$\frac{\partial\sqrt m}{\partial p}$ \quad $\frac{\partial p}{\sqrt\alpha}$
$\alpha = -\beta e^{\lambda 2a}$
$\beta = -\alpha e^{\lambda 2a} - \frac{2a}{n}\beta\lambda e^{\lambda 2a}$ \quad $\sqrt m = \int\frac{\partial p}{\sqrt\alpha}$
$[-\frac{2a}{n}-]e^{\lambda 2a} - e^{-\lambda 2a} = \frac{2a}{n}[-\beta-]\lambda$
$-n\mu' = \frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}(2a-p) - \mu \pm v$
$\frac{m'}{\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}}$ \quad $\frac{\partial m'}{\partial p}\frac{\partial m}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial p^2}m'$ \quad $\alpha = -\frac{n\mu'}{\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}} - (2a-p) - \frac{\mu}{\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}} + \frac{v}{\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}}$
$\frac{\partial m'}{\partial p}\frac{\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}}{\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial p^2}} - m'$ \quad $-\frac{n\mu}{\frac{\partial\mu'}{\partial p}} = \beta$
$\frac{\frac{\partial^2 m'}{\partial p^2} - \frac{\partial m'}{\partial p}\frac{\partial m}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^3 m}{\partial p^3}}{\left(\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial p^2}\right)^2}\beta = \frac{\frac{\mu}{\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}}n^2}{\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p} + \frac{\frac{\partial^2\mu}{\partial p^2}}{\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}}\alpha}$ \quad $\frac{\partial^2 m'}{\partial p^2}\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial p^2} - \frac{\partial m'}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^3 m}{\partial p^3}$
$n^2\mu = \beta\frac{\partial\alpha\frac{\partial\mu}{\partial p}}{\partial p}$
